description: This file defines the 'Font' class in the MigraDoc library, which encapsulates font styling and formatting properties such as name, size, bold, italic, underline, color, superscript, and subscript. It includes methods for cloning, applying font styles, and serialization, serving as a core component for document text styling.

classes.name: Font
classes.description: Represents the formatting of characters in a paragraph, including properties like font name, size, style, color, and scripts. Provides methods for cloning, applying styles, and serialization.

classes.name: Font.FontValues
classes.description: Internal class encapsulating the nullable values of the font properties, such as Name, Size, Bold, Italic, Underline, Color, Superscript, and Subscript.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Font object.

methods.name: ApplyFont
methods.description: Applies non-null properties from another Font object to this font, considering a reference font.

methods.name: ApplyFont
methods.description: Overload that copies non-null properties from the given Font to this font.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the Font object into DDL format for document serialization.

methods.name: CheckWhatIsNotNull
methods.description: Returns a bitmask indicating which properties of the Font are non-null.
